title: how to add blog sitemap
text:
Having XML sitemaps allows search engines to crawl and index a website sufficiently, and allowing all search engines to be notified of the site map by inserting it into the robots.txt file. In a nutshell, sitemaps enhance the ranking of a website in search engine results, thus boosting the SEO efforts.

New Blog allows automatic sitemap, which means everytime a post is published the sitemap gets automatically updated.

How does it work?

Go to Domain
Add the domain -Follow this article for Domain setup  [https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000000734-how-to-use-the-domain-connect-feature-] https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000000734-how-to-use-the-domain-connect-feature-
After adding the domain, in three dots the option to visit the XML Sitemap

 [image:  https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062561811/original/2uYrsa5_5sPHrBfvwVLRqg1NQVyN1xGzxA.png?1768314182] 

In XML Sitemap, step one is to select the landing pages/funnel to add by selecting the blog home and blog post option.
In step two, click on generate Sitemap 

Example -
